title: Normalized scalar-extension tensor comparison in independent universes
statement: Let C be a site essentially small in coefficient universe r, with the module-sheaf tensor and sheafification. For commutative ring sheaves R,S and φ:R→S, the tensor (Res S)⊗_R M is naturally isomorphic to Res(changeOfRings φ M), with the comparison sending the sheafified local tensor s⊗m to the sheafification of the same scalar-extension tensor. The regular tensor isomorphism R⊗M≅M has inverse x↦1⊗x. Tensor sheafification units commute with maps in the first factor. The site universes need not equal r.

source.place: Tags 06YP, 06YS, 06YY and Modules on Sites, Tag 03EK; normalized principal quotient construction.

proof.text: The section modules of restricted scalar extension and the tensor presheaf are identical, and the identity on pure tensors commutes with restrictions. Sheafify this presheaf isomorphism over R. The map from sheafification of a restricted presheaf to restriction of its S-sheafification is induced by the unit; after forgetting to abelian sheaves it is the identity, hence an isomorphism. Compose these maps with tensorObjIsoSheafification. Naturality of the sheafification unit gives the pure-tensor equation. For the regular tensor use the presheaf unitor and the sheafification counit; its inverse formula follows from the right triangle identity. Naturality of the counit and monoidal tensorator proves the first-variable tensor-unit formula.

theorem exists_extensionTensorComparison (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) :
    ∃ e : (monoidalCategory R).tensorObj
        ((restrictScalars.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
          (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))) M ≅
        (restrictScalars.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
          (changeOfRings φ M),
      ∀ (V : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj V) (m : M.val.obj V),
        e.hom.val.app V
          ((tensorPresheafUnit
            ((restrictScalars.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
              (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))) M).app V
            ((show ((restrictScalars.{r}
                ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
                  (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))).val.obj V
              from s) ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] m)) =
        (toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheaf φ M).presheaf).app V
          (s ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V, (φ.hom.app V).hom] m)
